description.en:
Basic Attack

Rover performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Rover consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack: Resonance

After Basic Attack 3 or Heavy Attack, press the Basic Attack button at the right time to perform Heavy Attack Resonance, dealing Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack: Aftertune

After Heavy Attack Resonance or Dodge Counter hits a target, press the Basic Attack button to perform Heavy Attack Aftertune, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Rover consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Rover melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Rover mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack: Resonance

Setelah Basic Attack 3 atau Heavy Attack, tekan tombol Basic Attack pada waktu yang tepat untuk melakukan Heavy Attack Resonance, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack: Aftertune

Setelah Heavy Attack Resonance atau Dodge Counter mengenai target, tekan tombol Basic Attack untuk melakukan Heavy Attack Aftertune, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Rover mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-Air Plunging Attack, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en: Rover launches an attack forward, dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id: Rover melancarkan serangan ke depan, memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en: Rover converges Spectro energy to assail the target area, detonating it after a short delay and dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id: Rover memusatkan energi Spectro untuk menghantam area target, meledakkannya setelah jeda singkat dan memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en: DMG dealt by Rover's Basic Attack Resonating Echoes is increased by 60%.
description.id: DMG yang diberikan oleh Basic Attack Resonating Echoes Rover meningkat sebesar 60%.

description.en: Rover gains 15% ATK increase for 5s upon casting Heavy Attack Resonance.
description.id: Rover mendapat peningkatan ATK sebesar 15% selama 5 dtk saat melancarkan Heavy Attack Resonance.

description.en: Rover attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id: Rover menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

skills.name: World in a Grain of Sand

description.en:
Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin

If "Diminutive Sound" exceeds 50 when Resonance Skill is used, Rover consumes 50 "Diminutive Sound" to cast Resonating Spin, dealing Spectro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes

After Resonance Skill Resonating Spin ends, Rover performs Resonating Echoes upon using Basic Attack button.
Launch attacks forward, dealing Spectro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

Diminutive Sound

Rover can hold up to 100 "Diminutive Sounds".
Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" for every Normal Attack Vibration Manifestation on hit.
Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" for every Heavy Attack Aftertune on hit.
Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" upon casting Intro Skill Waveshock.
description.id:
Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin

Jika "Diminutive Sound" melebihi 50 saat Resonance Skill digunakan, Rover mengonsumsi 50 "Diminutive Sound" untuk melancarkan Resonating Spin, memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes

Setelah Resonance Skill Resonating Spin berakhir, Rover melakukan Resonating Echoes saat menggunakan tombol Basic Attack.
Melancarkan serangan ke depan, memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

Diminutive Sound

Rover dapat menampung hingga 100 "Diminutive Sound".
Rover mendapat "Diminutive Sound" setiap kali Normal Attack Vibration Manifestation mengenai target.
Rover mendapat "Diminutive Sound" setiap kali Heavy Attack Aftertune mengenai target.
Rover mendapat "Diminutive Sound" saat melancarkan Intro Skill Waveshock.

description.en: Generate an area of stasis centered around the incoming Resonator, lasting for 3s.
description.id: Menciptakan area stasis yang berpusat pada Resonator yang masuk, berlangsung selama 3 dtk.

description.en: Channel Spectro energy to attack the target area, causing a blast after a short delay, dealing Spectro DMG and applying 6 stack(s) of Spectro Frazzle.
description.id: Menyalurkan energi Spectro untuk menyerang area target, menimbulkan ledakan setelah jeda singkat, memberikan Spectro DMG dan menimbulkan 6 stack Spectro Frazzle.

skills.name: World in a Grain of Sand

description.en:
Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin

If "Diminutive Sound" exceeds 50 when Resonance Skill is used, consume 50 "Diminutive Sound" to cast Resonating Spin, dealing Spectro DMG. This DMG is considered as Resonance Skill DMG and applies 2 stack(s) of Spectro Frazzle along with Shimmer.

Shimmer

Shimmer prevents Spectro Frazzle stacks from reducing over time.

Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes

After Resonance Skill Resonating Spin ends, follow up with Basic Attack to cast Resonating Echoes.
Launch forward to attack the enemies, dealing Spectro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

Diminutive Sound

Rover can hold up to 100 "Diminutive Sounds".
Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" for every Normal Attack Vibration Manifestation on hit.
Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" for every Heavy Attack Aftertune on hit.
Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" upon casting Intro Skill Waveshock.
description.id:
Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin

Jika "Diminutive Sound" melebihi 50 saat Resonance Skill digunakan, konsumsi 50 "Diminutive Sound" untuk melancarkan Resonating Spin, memberikan Spectro DMG. DMG ini dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG dan menimbulkan 2 stack Spectro Frazzle beserta Shimmer.

Shimmer

Shimmer mencegah stack Spectro Frazzle berkurang seiring waktu.

Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes

Setelah Resonance Skill Resonating Spin berakhir, lanjutkan dengan Basic Attack untuk melancarkan Resonating Echoes.
Melesat ke depan untuk menyerang musuh, memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

Diminutive Sound

Rover dapat menampung hingga 100 "Diminutive Sound".
Rover mendapat "Diminutive Sound" setiap kali Normal Attack Vibration Manifestation mengenai target.
Rover mendapat "Diminutive Sound" setiap kali Heavy Attack Aftertune mengenai target.
Rover mendapat "Diminutive Sound" saat melancarkan Intro Skill Waveshock.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Rover's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 7s when casting Resonance Skill Resonating Slashes or Resonance Skill Resonating Spin.
description.id: Crit. Rate Rover meningkat sebesar 15% selama 7 dtk saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Resonating Slashes atau Resonance Skill Resonating Spin.

description.en: Rover's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 20%.
description.id: Spectro DMG Bonus Rover meningkat sebesar 20%.

description.en: Rover's Energy Regen is increased by 20%.
When casting Resonance Liberation Echoing Resonance, Rover continuously restores HP for all team members: HP equal to 20% of Rover's ATK will be restored every second for 5s.
description.id: Saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation Echoing Resonance, Rover terus memulihkan HP seluruh anggota tim: HP sebesar 20% ATK Rover dipulihkan setiap detik selama 5 dtk.

description.en: Rover's Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 40%.
description.id: Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus Rover meningkat sebesar 40%.

description.en: Resonance Skill Resonating Slashes and Resonance Skill Resonating Spin reduces the target's Spectro RES by 10% on hit for 20s.
description.id: Resonance Skill Resonating Slashes dan Resonance Skill Resonating Spin mengurangi Spectro RES target sebesar 10% selama 20 dtk saat mengenai target.
